copy_gaps: Bar times 11:55-13:20: §4.1 names only 13:25, 13:30 and 13:35 (5m, L225-227); the 18 older bars are the kit's 5-minute steps back from the forming 13:35 (bar_times).
Price labels 63,974.0-64,008.0: §3 L192-193 fixes 40 rows of 1.0 USDT and §4.1 the top five (64,009.0-64,013.0, L220-224); the window below is the kit's (DEVIATIONS window).

D7 (L157) and §8.3 L763 mark the forming bar with the cap and the word 'forming' in the legend, but §4.9 L380-382's legend row has no such word and §4.1's sketch (L218) shows none: the legend reads 'FP Bid × Ask · rows 10 ticks · BTC' (kit legend_text). Carry for E18-D05 (to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): a legend '· forming' while the newest or cursor bar forms (D7 L157, §8.3 L763 against §4.9 L380-382); the boards draw it once settled.

The pressed cluster segment reads 'Live' in E11-D02 §7.2 (L267; the word is owner question O-E, 'Live' or 'Following'), while §4.1's sketch writes 'auto' (L227): the board keeps 'auto'; E11-D03 settles the word (O-E).
seed '20260928' (the bench CLI default) and cellsPerBar 40: §3 L172 names the generator but no seed; its default is 25 cells per bar
live_checks: cell digits: auto-width texts at a computed x (JetBrains Mono 0.6 em): check each side's digits share a right edge and the × column lines up; ▲ / ▼ must come from JetBrains Mono
rename frame 'SCR-030∕fp-anatomy' to 'SCR-030/fp-anatomy' after the board's last section (Penpot shows 'SCR-030 / fp-anatomy')
HOLD: do not render this frame live until the 13:35 POC carry on §4.1 L235 is settled on PR #4180 (deviations): every SCR-030 board copies this column (§0 L37-38).
No inst nodes: every control, chip and the legend are compositions (kit DEVIATIONS compose), so there is no set, variant or text layer to verify.

Pressed controls: [FP], Chart and the cluster's auto each lead with the 16 px `check` glyph in ink before the label, on the selected fill (3 check glyphs); the cluster's third segment is the chevron-right glyph, no '>' text. The wider cluster sits at x 2459.3 (was 2488.7; about 92.7 px wide), 22 px clear of the '13:35' label (E11-D02 §7.2: an 8 px exclusion zone): check nothing overlaps.

The legend block (about 263 px wide at x 4, y 4) overlays the 64,013.0 row of the first 3 columns, as the CMP-199 slot sits over the plot (E11-D02 §7.5): check its raised fill reads and the digits under it are covered, not clipped mid-glyph.

Layer order inside each bar column: wick, outlines (the 'o' ink frame with its 'i' paper inside), the cells bands, then the marks: digits must draw over the outlines, and the rails, ticks and brackets over the cells.

The 40 price labels: each '64,0xx.0' is about 48 px at type.num.xs in the 48 px gutter with 4 px padding, so it overhangs the plot by about 4 px into the 31 px free margin (DEVIATIONS axis): check none is cut.

After the last section: 21 'bar HH:MM' columns at x = i × 117 in the plot, 840 'r<n>' cell texts, 288 'o<row><side>' outlines, 7 brackets, 21 POC rail pairs, 42 VA ticks; no cap, ledge or stack label.
root: after the first section the root must read back exactly as the sheet's board.name
deviations: Two cells read '…' (13:25 and 13:30 at 64,009.0): §4.1 L224 elides them; the kit's anatomy overlay keeps the elision although the generator has values there, because those values (13:25 118 × 79, 13:30 36 × 26) would flag the 64,010.0 ask above them (702 / 118 = 5.95, 201 / 36 = 5.58), outlines the sketch rows do not draw (L220-224). PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): §4.1 L224 hand-picks the two cells so the sketch rows gain no outline (13:25: bid 235–2,105, ask ≤ 185; 13:30: bid 68–602, ask ≤ 557; an ask ≥ 21 / ≥ 63 also keeps the 40-row boards' 64,008.0 bid unflagged), then the boards draw those values.

13:35's POC rail is at 63,998.0, not the sketch's 64,011.0 (§4.1 L222's ═ rails): the forming bar trades all 40 rows here (§3 L193) and `24` §4.5 picks the row with the most volume (163 × 163 = 326 BTC against 64,011.0's 61 × 228 = 289). §4.7 L329 / L349 and §8.1 L731 call 64,011.0 the 13:35 POC, true of the five-row column (the kit's anatomy_scene); 64,011.0 stays inside 13:35's 40-row value area (63,985.0–64,012.0). PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane), before this frame is drawn live (every SCR-030 board copies this column, §0 L37-38): either (a) §4.1 L235 adds 'On the 40-row base boards the forming 13:35 bar's POC follows `24` §4.5 over its 40 rows (63,998.0); §4.7 L329/L349 and §8.1 L731 read the five-row column', or (b) §4.1 hand-picks 13:35's other base-board rows below 289 BTC so 64,011.0 stays the POC (4 rows reach 289 here: 63,975.0 312, 63,987.0 310, 63,998.0 326, 64,008.0 324).
Box's 'bordered cell per level, heat fill by colorScale' (§4.3 L271) is not drawn at L0: the fill is hi-fi colour (E18-D03; §0 L28-29) and §4.1's sketch draws digits only (L220-224).

Forming carrier: none on this frame. D7 (L157) and §8.3 L763 mark the forming bar with the cap and the word 'forming' in the legend; the cap clips at the plot's top (13:35's high is the window's top row: §3's 40 rows fill the 1,344 px pane; §4.5 L307 allows the clip) and §4.9 L380-382's legend row has no 'forming' (copy gap, carry for E18-D05). The status row's 'bar close 0:41' (CMP-226, §4.6 L314) says a bar is forming, not which column. Boards 21 and 28 draw the cap (§0 L63, L70; §5 L398).

Pressed states carry a CMP-019 `check` glyph (size.icon, ink) before the label, the selected fill kept as reinforcement: [FP] (the glyph stands for the sketch's '*', §4.1 L215), Chart (E11-D04 D1 L114, L139: E11-D02 D8's selected fill + check glyph) and the cluster's auto (E11-D02 D8 L115, §7.2 L267: the glyph is the ≥ 3:1 state carrier, the fill decorative, L493-495); §8.3 L771 asks a geometry or text carrier for every state. The kit's ctl() and time_strip() draw the fill alone, so gen_06 adds the glyph (e18kit.py not edited). Not drawn: E11-D04's color.border.strong reinforcement edge (not a wireframe grey) and the options' own glyphs icon/chart-candles and icon/table (registry request CR-D04-3; the words carry the options).

The cluster's third segment is E11-D02's `›` (D8 L115; §7.2 L267, named "Latest" in its name and tooltip), drawn as the CMP-019 chevron-right glyph; §4.1's ASCII sketch writes it '>' (L227). The nodes keep their names ('segment · >', 'cluster auto | fit | >') so the section paths hold.
The base scene's 40 rows span 63,974.0-64,013.0: the top row is the forming bar's high as §4.1 draws it (L219-220, the cap above 64,013.0); §3 L192-194 fixes 40 rows of 1.0 USDT but no prices.

Candles at dense: the strip is the 1 px wick + 1 px gap (§3 L179; D3 L153), so every bar draws its wick only, top to bottom (every row traded, §3 L193); bars.mjs's open and close (same seed) are kept in the scene but only break POC ties (`24` §4.5, the close).

Edge levels (no neighbour inside the bar) are not compared, as §4.1 draws its column (L233 'three outlined cells'; the sketch outlines no edge, L220-224). `24` §4.2 (L792) treats a neighbour outside the traded range as zero volume under zero_policy treat_as_min, a fixed default (spec §6.2 L535-537): all 42 edge sides here are non-zero (21 highs' bids, 21 lows' asks), so `24` would add 42 outlines (330, not 288) and 12:30 gains a ×3 sell stack 64,011.0–64,013.9. PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): either an A-row to `24` §4.2 'edge levels are not compared' (what the boards draw), or the boards draw the 42 edge outlines and §4.1 L233's count is corrected.

Kit geometry for marks the spec sizes only in part: POC rails 1 px on the level's top and bottom edges across the candle strip and the cells; VA ticks 2 px thick (6 px long, D6) at VAH's top edge and VAL's bottom edge; bracket end ticks as thick as the bracket; the cap spans the cells; folded columns draw brackets and VA ticks over the cells' outer edge (D4).
An imbalance outline is two rects: a 1.5 px ink frame (§4.4 L282: a token stroke is 1 or 2 px) and an inner rect in the cell's background; the digits draw over both.
D6's 'bold digits' at the POC are not drawn: no bold mono type token exists at 10 / 11 px (type.num.xs / .sm are regular); the rails carry the POC on the boards (hi-fi: E18-D03).
A stack's zone state is server-told (GAP-18, §4.4 L288-289); the kit draws 'active' (3 px) unless the board names another state.
A mark beyond the plot (the forming cap 1 px + 2 px above a column whose top is the window's top, an unfinished-auction ledge at the window's edge) is not drawn: §3's 40 rows fill the pane exactly.
The legend row and the corner badge sit on a raised fill so they read over the cells.

Price labels sit at E11-D02 §5's density gap (40 / 48 / 32 px) on whole-price steps; a label wider than §3's 48 / 56 px gutter floor (L177) extends left into the plot's free margin (memo §3.0: the bar counts are upper bounds).
Every control, chip, button, field, menu, tooltip, drawer and dialog is a composition named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance.

Frames are named as §0 names them ('SCR-030/fp-anatomy'), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so frame() names the node with U+2215 '∕' for '/' while sections address inside it; the live renderer renames each frame to its §0 name after the board's last section (live check).
